dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: The fresh and crisp morning air works wonders for lifting one's spirits. There's no better time to get a head start on any important tasks.

dialogues.speaker: Changsheng
dialogues.text: Hah, you both look wide awake and ready to seize the day... *yawn* You go on. I'm gonna snooze a while longer.
